mapper.select: SELECT participant.user_id FROM ( SELECT t.meter_reader_id AS user_id FROM meter_reading_task t WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.meter_reader_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT rm.resident_id AS user_id FROM meter_reading_task t INNER JOIN resident_meter rm ON rm.meter_id = t.meter_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} ) participant WHERE participant.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY participant.user_id
